employment role

  • CURIE: gmeow:employmentRole
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/employmentRole
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/employment

The role borne by this employment — a job title, position, or function. Functional: an employment has one canonical role at a time; a change of role is a new employment record or a standpoint-indexed claim. Specializes gmeow:hasRole.

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Employment -> gmeow:Role; functional Sub-property of: gmeow:hasRole

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:employmentRole from gmeow:Employment to gmeow:Role when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
